decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is peripheral to the firm's waste-to-energy direction and has not appeared on the website since 2019, so after four years the evidence suggests its value is unlikely to be realized and the option should be closed to free resources for core ventures.

The modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer and cost little to keep available, so despite reduced visibility the option stays open while plant deployments may still create demand.

The plastic-to-fuel plant is a flagship whose upside is still uncertain but potentially large, given growing pressure on plastic waste and energy prices in 2022, so the option is kept open even though its lack of visibility and the earlier withdrawal of the waste-oil plant raise the risk of abandonment.
